info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Variants (Batch) API

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number in a limited (paginated) list of products.

params.name: limit
params.description: Controls the number of items per page in a limited (paginated) list of products.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Fields to include, in a comma-separated list. The ID and the specified fields will be returned.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Fields to exclude, in a comma-separated list. The specified fields will be excluded from a response. The ID cannot be excluded.

params.name: product_id
params.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of products whose variants were requested. For example:`?product_id:in=77,80,81`

items.docs: Returns a list of all variants in your catalog. Optional parameters can be passed in.

Updates a batch of `variant` objects. Currently the limit is 50 variants however this is subject to change.

**Required Fields**

To update an existing variant:
* id (variant ID)

To create a new variant:
* product_id
* sku
* option_values
  - id (option_value ID - Example: 146)
  - option_id (Option ID - Example: 151)
